description: Read one page of the OnlyMCP documentation in full, as markdown. Meant for when the page is known by its short name; not for finding which page holds an answer. Answers the title, the address and the whole text of the page, including the commands and configuration it shows. Reads only public documentation.

language.description: Language of the answer: en (default), de, fr or it. A page not yet translated comes back in English.

slug.description: Short name of the page, as it stands in the address after /docs/.

name: read_doc
title: Read a documentation page
